priorityList: Use Potion and Power Infusion during Dragonrage for maximum burst damage.
Cast Dragonrage as your primary cooldown, ensuring the target will survive for its duration.
Use Tip the Scales during Dragonrage to instantly cast an empowered spell, prioritizing Eternity Surge.
Cast Deep Breath if the Strafing Run buff is about to expire to maintain its benefit.
Cast Eternity Surge at Empowerment Level 1.
Cast Fire Breath at Empowerment Level 1.
Cast Disintegrate whenever Mass Disintegrate stacks are active to consume the Scalecommander proc.
Cast Disintegrate as your primary Essence spender, chaining it when at 1 tick remaining to maximize efficiency.
Cast Living Flame when Burnout procs or if Leaping Flames/Ancient Flame buffs are active.
Cast Azure Sweep if the Mid1 2-piece set bonus is active to trigger its benefit.
Cast Living Flame as your primary filler while standing still.
Cast Azure Strike as a filler during movement if Hover is unavailable.
Use Hover whenever movement is required or to allow casting of Disintegrate and Empowered spells on the move.
Use on-use Trinkets during Dragonrage, ideally after building stacks of Rising Fury.
Use Quell to interrupt enemy spellcasting whenever needed.
